query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Retrieve Trello card comments, update Trello cards, and perform broader project-management and automation-maintenance operations across task boards, email, chat, and an automation platform.

requirement_groups.purpose: update card information or close status

query_ground_truth.rationale: The workflow requires updating Trello cards as part of project management and automation maintenance.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the provided card identifier maps to the idCard expected by TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD, and confirm the exact final name/description text to avoid unintended overwrites.
[Optional (if the card identifier is unknown/ambiguous)] [Prerequisite]: Locate and select the correct card using TRELLO_GET_SEARCH (capture idCard from results).
[Optional (if you must append/merge instead of replace)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch current name/desc using TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD and compose the final merged text locally before writing.
[Required] [Step]: Update intended fields in one write using TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD (set only name and/or desc; leave unrelated fields unset).
[Optional (if the combined update fails or only description must change)] [Fallback]: Update description only using TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_DESC_BY_ID_CARD (minimize unintended changes).
[Optional (for verification when exact final text matters)] [Next Step]: Re-fetch using TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD to confirm stored name/desc match expectations.
[Optional (if you need an audit note)] [Next Step]: Add a comment using TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ACTIONS_COMMENTS_BY_ID_CARD (record what changed and why).
known_pitfalls: [TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD] Providing name/desc replaces the full field value; for append/merge edits, read first with TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD and send the combined result (desc limit is ~16384 chars).
[TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD] Identifier/schema mismatch: the tool expects the parameter named idCard, so ensure the known identifier is mapped correctly.
[TRELLO_GET_SEARCH] Can return 400 Invalid objectId with certain scoped parameters; recover by broadening the query and relying on returned idCard.
[TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD] Update response may omit or truncate desc (especially for larger descriptions); verify by re-reading with TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD.
[TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_DESC_BY_ID_CARD] New description must be passed in the parameter named "value" or validation may fail with missing-field errors.

TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD.description: Updates an existing Trello card's attributes like name, description, due date, members, labels, position, or archives/unarchives it, attaches files, or changes its cover.

due.description: The new due date for the card, in ISO 8601 format, or 'null' to remove the due date.

pos.description: The new position of the card within its list. Can be 'top', 'bottom', or a positive floating-point number. Higher numbers are further down the list.

desc.description: The new description for the card. String length must be from 0 to 16384 characters.

name.description: The new name for the card. Required if not copying the name from `idCardSource`, `fileSource`, or `urlSource`.

closed.description: Determines whether the card should be archived (closed). Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card to update.

idList.description: The ID of the list to move the card to.

labels.description: Comma-separated list of label colors (e.g., 'green,yellow,red') to apply, overwriting existing labels. Use 'idLabels' for more precise control. 'all' may add all available label colors.

idBoard.description: The ID of the board to move the card to. If `idList` is also provided, the card will be moved to that list on the new board.

idLabels.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs to apply, replacing existing labels. To preserve existing labels, fetch current `idLabels`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

idMembers.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs to assign, replacing existing members. To preserve existing members, fetch current `idMembers`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

urlSource.description: A URL to be attached to the card (e.g., a link to an external resource). If the card is being created from a URL (e.g. via a bookmarklet), this will be the source URL. Set to 'null' or an empty string to remove an existing attachment link created this way.

fileSource.description: The URL of a file to be attached to the card. Trello will fetch and attach the file from this URL.

subscribed.description: Determines whether the user is subscribed to the card. Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCardSource.description: The ID of a card to copy properties from. Requires `keepFromSource` to be specified.

keepFromSource.description: If `idCardSource` is specified, this is a comma-separated list of properties to copy from the source card. Valid values are 'all', or any combination of 'attachments', 'checklists', 'comments', 'customFields', 'due', 'labels', 'members', 'pluginData', 'stickers'.

idAttachmentCover.description: The ID of an existing image attachment to be used as the card cover. Use 'null' or an empty string to remove the cover.

TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD.description: Retrieves a Trello card by its ID or shortlink, with options to include related data like actions, attachments, members, and checklists.

list.description: Include data for the card's list. Use 'true' or 'false'.

board.description: Include data for the card's board. Use 'true' or 'false'.

fields.default: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idShort, idAttachmentCover, manualCoverAttachment, labels, name, pos, shortUrl and url
fields.description: Fields for the card: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'name,desc'). Valid: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, url.

idCard.description: The unique identifier or shortlink of the Trello card. Must be either a 24-character hexadecimal ID (e.g., '5abbe4b7ddc1b351ef961414') or an 8-character alphanumeric shortlink (e.g., 'H0TZyzbK'). Short numeric strings like '6514' are not valid.

actions.description: Actions to return: 'all' or a comma-separated list of types (e.g., 'addAttachmentToCard', 'commentCard', 'updateCard'). For a complete list of types, consult the Trello API documentation.

list_fields.description: Fields for the list: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'name,pos'). Valid: closed, idBoard, name, pos, subscribed.

board_fields.default: name, desc, descData, closed, idOrganization, pinned, url and prefs
board_fields.description: Fields for the board: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'name,desc'). Valid: closed, dateLastActivity, dateLastView, desc, descData, idOrganization, invitations, invited, labelNames, memberships, name, pinned, powerUps, prefs, shortLink, shortUrl, starred, subscribed, url.

membersVoted.description: Include data for members who voted. Use 'true' or 'false'.

action_fields.description: Fields for actions: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'data,date'). Valid: data, date, idMemberCreator, type.

member_fields.description: Fields for members: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'avatarHash,fullName'). Valid: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

sticker_fields.description: Fields for stickers: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'image,left'). Valid: image, imageScaled, imageUrl, left, rotate, top, zIndex.

actions_display.description: Return display-friendly action data. Use 'true' or 'false'.

checkItemStates.description: Include check item states. Use 'true' or 'false'.

actions_entities.description: Include entities (e.g., card, board, member) for actions. Use 'true' or 'false'.

checklist_fields.description: Fields for checklists: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'idBoard,name'). Valid: idBoard, idCard, name, pos.

attachment_fields.description: Fields for attachments: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'bytes,date'). Valid: bytes, date, edgeColor, idMember, isUpload, mimeType, name, previews, url.

memberVoted_fields.description: Fields for members who voted: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'avatarHash,fullName'). Valid: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

checkItemState_fields.description: Fields for check item states: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'idCheckItem,state'). Valid: idCheckItem, state.

action_memberCreator_fields.description: Fields for the action creator: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'avatarHash,fullName'). Valid: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

TRELLO_GET_SEARCH.description: Searches Trello content (e.g., boards, cards, members) within specified organizations using a query and customizable result fields. IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: - Search indexing has a delay: newly created/updated cards may not appear for several minutes. - For exact name matching or time-sensitive lookups, use TRELLO_GET_LISTS_CARDS_BY_ID_LIST or TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_CARDS_BY_ID_BOARD to enumerate cards directly, then filter by name. - The search uses word tokenization: queries like 'Payment failed when sending tips' are split into individual terms ['Payment', 'failed', 'when', 'sending', 'tips']. Common words may be ignored. - Set partial='true' (default) for better recall with prefix matching on the last search term.

query.description: The search query string. Trello tokenizes the query into individual words and searches for cards/boards/etc. containing those terms. Note: Common words like 'when', 'the', 'is' may be ignored as stop words.

idCards.description: A comma-separated list of card IDs to search for. Each card ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f'). Do NOT use the short card ID from the card URL.

partial.description: Enable partial/prefix matching for search terms ('true' or 'false'). Default is 'true'. When true, the last word in the query will match word prefixes (e.g., 'pay' matches 'payment'). When false, only exact word matches are returned. Setting to 'true' (recommended) improves search recall, especially for card names that may not be indexed immediately after creation.

idBoards.description: A comma-separated list of board IDs to search within, or 'mine' to search all boards the user is a member of (default). Each board ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f'). Do NOT use the short 8-character ID from the board URL (e.g., 'VGflYpta' from 'trello.com/b/VGflYpta/board-name'). To get the correct ID, use the TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER action or extract it from API responses.

card_list.description: Whether to include the list object for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

card_board.description: Whether to include the board object for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

cards_page.description: Page number for paginated card results. Must be 0-100. Default is 0.

modelTypes.description: Types of Trello objects to search (e.g., 'cards,boards' or 'all' from 'actions', 'boards', 'cards', 'members', 'organizations'). Default is 'all'.

card_fields.description: Fields for found cards; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,due'). Default is 'all'.

cards_limit.description: Maximum number of card results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude cards from search results. Default is 10.

board_fields.description: Fields for found boards; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,url'). Default is 'name,idOrganization'.

boards_limit.description: Maximum number of board results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude boards from search results. Default is 10.

card_members.description: Whether to include member objects for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

card_stickers.description: Whether to include sticker objects for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

member_fields.description: Fields for found members; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'fullName,username'). Default is 'avatarHash,fullName,initials,username,confirmed'.

members_limit.description: Maximum number of member results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude members from search results. Default is 10.

idOrganizations.description: A comma-separated list of organization (workspace) IDs to search within. Each organization ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f').

card_attachments.description: Whether to include attachments for cards ('true', 'false', or 'cover' for card cover attachments).

organization_fields.description: Fields for found organizations; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,url'). Default is 'name,displayName'.

organizations_limit.description: Maximum number of organization results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude organizations from search results. Default is 10.
